name: AI Security Log Summarization - Daily Briefing (WhatsApp + Email) - Advanced

parameters.content:
## 🛡️ AI Security Log Summarization — Daily Briefing (Advanced)

**What it does:** pulls the last 24 hours of security events from a central log aggregator, normalizes and de-duplicates them, has an LLM turn the noise into a short daily briefing, escalates to a human when either the AI or a deterministic rule-based fail-safe flags something urgent, and delivers the result on both WhatsApp (short) and email (detailed) — every day.

### 🆕 What's new vs the basic version
- **Rule-based fail-safe escalation** — a deterministic check (critical-category hits, statistical volume spikes, critical-source silence) runs independently of the LLM, so a single AI mis-classification can never suppress a real escalation
- **Rolling baseline spike detection** — each category's count is compared against its own 14-day rolling average (z-score) to catch abnormal volume, not just absolute thresholds
- **Logging coverage-gap detection** — flags any configured system that reported zero events this cycle, since a silent system usually means a broken pipeline, not a quiet day
- **Escalation timeout handling** — the acknowledgment wait auto-resumes if the security lead doesn't respond in time, and notifies a backup on-call contact instead of silently proceeding
- **Weekly trend digest** — a separate weekly email aggregates 7 days of history into week-over-week category trends, persistent offending IPs, and an escalation count

## 1️⃣ Trigger, Config & Multi-System Normalization

- **Schedule Trigger - Daily Morning Briefing** — fires automatically every day at 07:00 to start the run.
- **Manual Trigger - Test Run** — lets you run the whole workflow on demand for testing.
- **Set - Config** — central place to set the SIEM URL, thresholds, contacts, and every other config value. 🔑
- **HTTP Request - Fetch Aggregated Security Logs** — calls the SIEM/log aggregator API for the last 24h of events. 🔑
- **JS - Normalize, Categorize & Score Log Events** — normalizes, categorizes, dedupes, scores, and totals the raw events.

## 2️⃣ Deterministic Fail-Safe (Runs Before the AI)

- **JS - Detect Coverage Gaps & Spike Score** — deterministically flags silent systems and statistical volume spikes, independent of the LLM, and updates the rolling baseline.

## 3️⃣ AI Summary, Dual-Format Report & Combined Escalation

- **OpenAI Chat Model** — the LLM used by the summarizer node. 🔑
- **AI - Summarize Security Events** — turns the event data into an executive summary, findings, and risk level.
- **JS - Parse AI Summary & Build Briefing Payloads** — parses the AI output, merges escalation flags, builds the WhatsApp/email content.
- **IF - Escalation Required** — branches to the acknowledgment wait if escalation is needed, else straight to delivery.

## 4️⃣ Acknowledgment Wait, With a Timeout Fallback

- **Wait - For Security Lead Acknowledgment** — pauses for a webhook ack, auto-resuming after the configured timeout.
- **JS - Check Acknowledgment Status** — determines whether the Wait resumed via a real ack or a timeout.
- **IF - Escalation Timed Out** — branches to notify the backup on-call if no acknowledgment arrived in time.
- **WhatsApp - Notify Backup On-Call** — pages a backup contact when the primary didn't acknowledge. 🔑

## 5️⃣ Daily Delivery on Both Channels

- **WhatsApp - Send Daily Security Briefing** — sends the short daily briefing text via WhatsApp. 🔑
- **Email - Send Daily Security Briefing** — sends the detailed HTML daily briefing via email. 🔑

## 📊 Weekly Trend Digest (Separate Branch)

- **Schedule Trigger - Weekly Trend Digest** — fires every Monday at 08:00 to start the weekly run.
- **Set - Weekly Digest Config** — holds the recipient and from address for the weekly digest email.
- **JS - Build Weekly Trend Report** — aggregates 7 days of history into week-over-week trends and stats.
- **Email - Send Weekly Trend Digest** — sends the weekly trend report via email. 🔑
